sections.title: 🎯  OP BOARD
sections.body:
> Fifteen operations, written up so anybody can pick one and run it.

Press a button. You get the ops in that tier, only you can see them, and the op card in each one pastes straight into `/op create`.

The tiers are about **how hard it is to host**, not how hard the fight is.

sections.title: 📖  WHAT EACH ONE GIVES YOU
sections.body:
Every op comes with what it needs, how long it runs, why it is worth an hour, and a ready-made op card.

The full brief for any of them, with phases, roles, win conditions and what goes wrong, is in the Operations Playbook.

fields.name: 🟢  Easy
fields.value: Five ops. No prep, no specialists, runs at four people.

fields.name: 🟡  Medium
fields.value: Five ops. Needs a plan and a scoreline.

fields.name: 🔴  Hard
fields.value: Five ops. Ninety minutes or another faction.

sections.title: 🎙  HOSTING ONE
sections.body:
You do not need a rank to host. Claim one in here so nobody doubles up, then `/op create` to post the card and `/op close` afterwards to record who actually showed.

Closing it is what puts everyone's attendance on the record, so an op nobody closes is an op that counted for nobody.
